values.note: Campspot list prices for July 13-15, 2027 (not yet bookable, past the 210-day window): Electric Sites $44 a night, the cheapest type a motorhome may book; Rustic Sites $30 are sold to vans only, to 20 ft, and walk-in tent sites $30. One rate for everyone, no resident split. Every reservation or date change costs a $4 booking fee; locking a specific site $10; extra tents a nightly fee. Cancellation 14+ days out refunds less $30 per site.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/park/barnes-park-campground?checkin=2027-07-13&checkout=2027-07-15 (Electric Sites $44/night, Rustic Sites $30, Rustic Walk-In Tent Site $30) + https://www.campspot.com/barnes-park-campground/site/5806 (Rustic Sites: equipment 'Van', max length 20 ft) + make_a_reservation.php ('All reservations and any reservation alterations in dates, are charged a $4 booking fee', '$10 lock fee', 'cancellation fee per site ($30)'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Camping from the Friday of Memorial Day weekend to mid-October, 'weather and staff pending'; the park itself is open year-round for day use.

season.source: make_a_reservation.php ('Camping season: May (Friday of Memorial Day Weekend) to mid-October, weather and staff pending') + index.php ('seasonal camping and pavilion rentals (Memorial Day through October.)'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Two modern bathhouses; showers are coin-operated ($0.50 for 5 minutes, quarters only).

facilities.source: https://www.antrimcountymi.gov/departments___services_/parks___recreation/parks/barnes_park_campground/index.php ('Dump station & water fill station', 'Camp Store offering ice, firewood, beverages', 'Two modern bathhouses with shower facilities ... Showers are coin operated'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: By reservation only since 2020, on the county's Campspot page. Reservations for the season open April 12 at midnight; the first days take only long stays (the county says 5+ nights on April 12-13; Campspot's own type text says 7 nights for electric sites booked April 12-14). After that 2 nights minimum, 3 on holiday weekends. The site you book may be moved unless you pay the $10 lock fee. Petoskey Stone Festival camping (mid-May) is by phone, first come, first served.

booking.source: make_a_reservation.php ('We require a 2-night minimum stay for non-holiday & 3-night minimum stay for holiday weekends', 'April 12th and 13th is open for reservations of 5-nights or more', 'The park has been by reservation only since 2020') + Campspot Electric Sites text ('Reservations made between April 12th and April 14th require a minimum of 7 nights'), read 2026-10-25

note: Antrim County park on Grand Traverse Bay (Lake Michigan) near Eastport, ~0.6 mi W of US-31/M-88: spacious wooded sites, Lake Michigan beach, playground, trails and two pavilions. One trailer/RV per site. --Claude
summary: County pages + its Campspot engine: fees 30-44 -> 44-44 (the $30 rustic sites are sold to vans to 20 ft only, so the base is the $44 electric site; $4 booking fee); added 50-amp, season (Memorial Day Friday - mid-October), coin showers, dump, water fill, camp store; confirmed Campspot reservation-only with a 2-night minimum (3 on holidays). Site count / lengths left (Campspot showed only part of the site list). Note cleaned of booking, minimum and fee facts the fields hold.
